environment: Local Linux/amd64 Docker worker and Chromium headless shell. Both use network none. The synthetic HTTPS broker fixture is loopback within the worker. The real renderer uses the shared Unix socket.
method: One directory, one card/revision/check. Reopen the on-disk acknowledgement journal for every claim, with no adapter state carried over. Replay the first discovery before acknowledging it. Validate every expected URL and SHA-256, deduplicate a cycle and record the oversized file separately.

inputs.details: Two buttons request attachments using fetch, including the same oversized PDF linked from the root. File headers can be probed during discovery without consuming the body.

correction: When adding the fetch buttons to this same fixture, the initial request-count assertion expected only two GETs for the oversized file. Three are required: the tail attempt which returns earlier successes, the leading item rejection on the next claim, and the header-only button discovery. The corrected exact count passed.

scope: This adapter receipt covers bounded discovery and replay with a durable fixture journal. The production Firestore transaction, worker scheduling and user-visible failure reporting are owned by work package 004.
